description: Jacobian J and mass matrix M, one value per pattern entry (rows, cols), of a porous-electrode lithium-ion cell model (graphite and NMC532 electrodes of 20 volumes, a separator of 10, Fickian particles) after a C/2 charge of 1800 s and a 3600 s rest, in the model's dimensionless units. Its impedance operator is i w M - J.
